<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="Definitions_Internship" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/internship">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Offer" name="Offer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_AcceptOffer" name="Offer accepted"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_DenyOffer" name="Offer denied"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_CompanyStatusUpdate1" name="Company status update 1"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_CompanyStatusUpdate2" name="Company status update 2"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_CompanyStatusUpdate3" name="Company status update 3"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Tweet" name="Recommendation tweet"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Internship">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Student" name="Student" processRef="Process_Student"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Company"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Twitter" name="Twitter"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_OfferReceived" name="Offer" sourceRef="Participant_Company" targetRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_OfferReceived" messageRef="Msg_Offer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_AcceptOffer" name="Offer accepted" sourceRef="SendTask_AcceptOffer" targetRef="Participant_Company" messageRef="Msg_AcceptOffer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_DenyOffer" name="Offer denied" sourceRef="SendTask_DenyOffer" targetRef="Participant_Company" messageRef="Msg_DenyOffer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CompanyUpdate1" name="Company status update 1" sourceRef="Participant_Company" targetRef="ReceiveTask_CompanyUpdate1" messageRef="Msg_CompanyStatusUpdate1"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CompanyUpdate2" name="Company status update 2" sourceRef="Participant_Company" targetRef="ReceiveTask_CompanyUpdate2" messageRef="Msg_CompanyStatusUpdate2"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CompanyUpdate3" name="Company status update 3" sourceRef="Participant_Company" targetRef="ReceiveTask_CompanyUpdate3" messageRef="Msg_CompanyStatusUpdate3"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Tweet" name="Recommendation tweet" sourceRef="SendTask_TweetRecommendation" targetRef="Participant_Twitter" messageRef="Msg_Tweet"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Student" name="Internship (Student)" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Start" name="Start internship search">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_EnterPreferences" name="Enter topic, desired salary, experience and hobbies">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Prefs</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OffersMerge" name="Offers pending">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Prefs</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DenyToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToOffer</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatchEvent_OfferReceived" name="Offer received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToOffer</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OfferToReview</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_OfferReceived" messageRef="Msg_Offer"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_ReviewOffer" name="Review offer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OfferToReview</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OfferDecision" name="Accept offer?" default="Flow_OfferDenied">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToDecision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OfferAccepted</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OfferDenied</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_AcceptOffer" name="Send offer acceptance" messageRef="Msg_AcceptOffer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OfferAccepted</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AcceptToInvalidate</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:serviceTask id="ServiceTask_InvalidateOtherOffers" name="Invalidate all other offers">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AcceptToInvalidate</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InvalidateToSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:serviceTask>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_DenyOffer" name="Send offer denial" messageRef="Msg_DenyOffer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OfferDenied</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DenyToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_InternshipSplit" name="Internship running">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InvalidateToSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SplitToStatus1</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SplitToCompany1</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_StatusUpdate1" name="Write status update 1 (weekly)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SplitToStatus1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Status1ToStatus2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_StatusUpdate2" name="Write status update 2 (weekly)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Status1ToStatus2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Status2ToStatus3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_StatusUpdate3" name="Write status update 3 (weekly)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Status2ToStatus3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Status3ToJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_CompanyUpdate1" name="Receive company status update 1" messageRef="Msg_CompanyStatusUpdate1">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SplitToCompany1</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Company1ToCompany2</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_CompanyUpdate2" name="Receive company status update 2" messageRef="Msg_CompanyStatusUpdate2">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Company1ToCompany2</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Company2ToCompany3</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_CompanyUpdate3" name="Receive company status update 3" messageRef="Msg_CompanyStatusUpdate3">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Company2ToCompany3</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Company3ToJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_InternshipJoin" name="Internship finished">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Status3ToJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Company3ToJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_JoinToTweet</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_TweetRecommendation" name="Tweet recommendation of company to friend" messageRef="Msg_Tweet">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_JoinToTweet</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TweetToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics isSequential="false"/>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_End" name="Recommendations sent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TweetToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start" sourceRef="StartEvent_Start" targetRef="UserTask_EnterPreferences"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Prefs" sourceRef="UserTask_EnterPreferences" targetRef="Gateway_OffersMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToOffer" sourceRef="Gateway_OffersMerge" targetRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_OfferReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OfferToReview" sourceRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_OfferReceived" targetRef="UserTask_ReviewOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToDecision" sourceRef="UserTask_ReviewOffer" targetRef="Gateway_OfferDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OfferAccepted" sourceRef="Gateway_OfferDecision" targetRef="SendTask_AcceptOffer">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance">${offerAccepted == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OfferDenied" sourceRef="Gateway_OfferDecision" targetRef="SendTask_DenyOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AcceptToInvalidate" sourceRef="SendTask_AcceptOffer" targetRef="ServiceTask_InvalidateOtherOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InvalidateToSplit" sourceRef="ServiceTask_InvalidateOtherOffers" targetRef="Gateway_InternshipSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DenyToMerge" sourceRef="SendTask_DenyOffer" targetRef="Gateway_OffersMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToStatus1" sourceRef="Gateway_InternshipSplit" targetRef="UserTask_StatusUpdate1"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToCompany1" sourceRef="Gateway_InternshipSplit" targetRef="ReceiveTask_CompanyUpdate1"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Status1ToStatus2" sourceRef="UserTask_StatusUpdate1" targetRef="UserTask_StatusUpdate2"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Status2ToStatus3" sourceRef="UserTask_StatusUpdate2" targetRef="UserTask_StatusUpdate3"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Status3ToJoin" sourceRef="UserTask_StatusUpdate3" targetRef="Gateway_InternshipJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company1ToCompany2" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_CompanyUpdate1" targetRef="ReceiveTask_CompanyUpdate2"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company2ToCompany3" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_CompanyUpdate2" targetRef="ReceiveTask_CompanyUpdate3"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Company3ToJoin" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_CompanyUpdate3" targetRef="Gateway_InternshipJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinToTweet" sourceRef="Gateway_InternshipJoin" targetRef="SendTask_TweetRecommendation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TweetToEnd" sourceRef="SendTask_TweetRecommendation" targetRef="EndEvent_End"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SplitToReceive</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_WriteStatusUpdates" name="Write at least 3 status updates about internship every week">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SplitToWrite</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_WriteToJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics testBefore="false" loopMaximum="3"/>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_CompanyStatusUpdates" name="Receive 3 status updates about student from company" messageRef="Msg_CompanyStatusUpdate">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SplitToReceive</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReceiveToJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics testBefore="false" loopMaximum="3"/>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_InternshipJoin" name="Internship finished">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_WriteToJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReceiveToJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_JoinToTweet</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_TweetRecommendation" name="Tweet recommendation of company to friends" messageRef="Msg_Tweet">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_JoinToTweet</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TweetToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics isSequential="false"/>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_End" name="Recommendations sent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TweetToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start" sourceRef="StartEvent_Start" targetRef="UserTask_EnterTopic"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TopicToSalary" sourceRef="UserTask_EnterTopic" targetRef="UserTask_EnterSalary"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SalaryToExperience" sourceRef="UserTask_EnterSalary" targetRef="UserTask_EnterExperience"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ExperienceToHobbies" sourceRef="UserTask_EnterExperience" targetRef="UserTask_EnterHobbies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HobbiesToMerge" sourceRef="UserTask_EnterHobbies" targetRef="Gateway_OffersMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToOffer" sourceRef="Gateway_OffersMerge" targetRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_OfferReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OfferToDecision" sourceRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_OfferReceived" targetRef="UserTask_AcceptOrDenyOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToDecision" sourceRef="UserTask_AcceptOrDenyOffer" targetRef="Gateway_OfferDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OfferAccepted" sourceRef="Gateway_OfferDecision" targetRef="Task_InvalidateOtherOffers">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${offerAccepted == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DenyToMerge" sourceRef="Gateway_OfferDecision" targetRef="Gateway_OffersMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InvalidateToSplit" sourceRef="Task_InvalidateOtherOffers" targetRef="Gateway_InternshipSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToWrite" sourceRef="Gateway_InternshipSplit" targetRef="UserTask_WriteStatusUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToReceive" sourceRef="Gateway_InternshipSplit" targetRef="ReceiveTask_CompanyStatusUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WriteToJoin" sourceRef="UserTask_WriteStatusUpdates" targetRef="Gateway_InternshipJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveToJoin" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_CompanyStatusUpdates" targetRef="Gateway_InternshipJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinToTweet" sourceRef="Gateway_InternshipJoin" targetRef="SendTask_TweetRecommendation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TweetToEnd" sourceRef="SendTask_TweetRecommendation" targetRef="EndEvent_End"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_Internship" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn/internship">
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Offer" name="Offer"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_CompanyStatusUpdate" name="Status update about student"/>
  <bpmn:message id="Msg_Tweet" name="Recommendation tweet"/>

  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_Internship">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Student" name="Student" processRef="Process_Student"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Company" name="Company"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Twitter" name="Twitter"/>

    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Offer" name="Offer" sourceRef="Participant_Company" targetRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_OfferReceived" messageRef="Msg_Offer"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_CompanyStatusUpdate" name="Status update about student" sourceRef="Participant_Company" targetRef="ReceiveTask_CompanyStatusUpdates" messageRef="Msg_CompanyStatusUpdate"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Tweet" name="Recommendation tweet" sourceRef="SendTask_TweetRecommendation" targetRef="Participant_Twitter" messageRef="Msg_Tweet"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_Student" name="Internship (Student)" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_Start" name="Start internship search">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_Start</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_EnterTopic" name="Enter topic of interest">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_Start</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TopicToMoney</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_EnterMoney" name="Enter desired money">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TopicToMoney</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_MoneyToExperience</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_EnterExperience" name="Enter experience">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_MoneyToExperience</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ExperienceToHobbies</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_EnterHobbies" name="Enter hobbies">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ExperienceToHobbies</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_HobbiesToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OffersMerge" name="Offers pending">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_HobbiesToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DenyToMerge</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToOffer</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="IntermediateCatchEvent_OfferReceived" name="Offer received">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToOffer</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OfferToDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:messageEventDefinition id="MED_OfferReceived" messageRef="Msg_Offer"/>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>

    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_AcceptOrDenyOffer" name="Accept or deny offer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OfferToDecision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ToDecision</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:userTask>

    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_OfferDecision" name="Offer accepted?" default="Flow_OfferDenied">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ToDecision</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OfferAccepted</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_OfferDenied</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:exclusiveGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_DenyOffer" name="Deny offer">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OfferDenied</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DenyToMerge</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_AcceptSplit" name="Offer accepted">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_OfferAccepted</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SplitToInvalidate</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SplitToStart</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:task id="Task_InvalidateOtherOffers" name="Invalidate all other offers">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SplitToInvalidate</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_InvalidateToAcceptJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_StartInternship" name="Start internship">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SplitToStart</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StartToAcceptJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_AcceptJoin" name="Offer accepted and follow-up done">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_InvalidateToAcceptJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StartToAcceptJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AcceptJoinToSplit</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_InternshipSplit" name="Internship running">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AcceptJoinToSplit</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SplitToWrite</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_SplitToReceive</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:userTask id="UserTask_WriteStatusUpdates" name="Write status updates about internship (at least 3, every week)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SplitToWrite</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_WriteToJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics testBefore="false" loopMaximum="3"/>
    </bpmn:userTask>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="ReceiveTask_CompanyStatusUpdates" name="Receive status updates about student from company (3 times)" messageRef="Msg_CompanyStatusUpdate">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_SplitToReceive</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ReceiveToJoin</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:standardLoopCharacteristics testBefore="false" loopMaximum="3"/>
    </bpmn:receiveTask>

    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="Gateway_InternshipJoin" name="Internship finished">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_WriteToJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ReceiveToJoin</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_JoinToTweet</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:parallelGateway>

    <bpmn:sendTask id="SendTask_TweetRecommendation" name="Recommend company to friends via Twitter" messageRef="Msg_Tweet">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_JoinToTweet</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TweetToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
      <bpmn:multiInstanceLoopCharacteristics isSequential="false"/>
    </bpmn:sendTask>

    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_End" name="Recommendations sent">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TweetToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start" sourceRef="StartEvent_Start" targetRef="UserTask_EnterTopic"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TopicToMoney" sourceRef="UserTask_EnterTopic" targetRef="UserTask_EnterMoney"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_MoneyToExperience" sourceRef="UserTask_EnterMoney" targetRef="UserTask_EnterExperience"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ExperienceToHobbies" sourceRef="UserTask_EnterExperience" targetRef="UserTask_EnterHobbies"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_HobbiesToMerge" sourceRef="UserTask_EnterHobbies" targetRef="Gateway_OffersMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToOffer" sourceRef="Gateway_OffersMerge" targetRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_OfferReceived"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OfferToDecision" sourceRef="IntermediateCatchEvent_OfferReceived" targetRef="UserTask_AcceptOrDenyOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ToDecision" sourceRef="UserTask_AcceptOrDenyOffer" targetRef="Gateway_OfferDecision"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OfferAccepted" sourceRef="Gateway_OfferDecision" targetRef="Gateway_AcceptSplit">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">${offerAccepted == true}</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_OfferDenied" sourceRef="Gateway_OfferDecision" targetRef="Task_DenyOffer"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DenyToMerge" sourceRef="Task_DenyOffer" targetRef="Gateway_OffersMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToInvalidate" sourceRef="Gateway_AcceptSplit" targetRef="Task_InvalidateOtherOffers"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToStart" sourceRef="Gateway_AcceptSplit" targetRef="Task_StartInternship"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_InvalidateToAcceptJoin" sourceRef="Task_InvalidateOtherOffers" targetRef="Gateway_AcceptJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToAcceptJoin" sourceRef="Task_StartInternship" targetRef="Gateway_AcceptJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AcceptJoinToSplit" sourceRef="Gateway_AcceptJoin" targetRef="Gateway_InternshipSplit"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToWrite" sourceRef="Gateway_InternshipSplit" targetRef="UserTask_WriteStatusUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SplitToReceive" sourceRef="Gateway_InternshipSplit" targetRef="ReceiveTask_CompanyStatusUpdates"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_WriteToJoin" sourceRef="UserTask_WriteStatusUpdates" targetRef="Gateway_InternshipJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ReceiveToJoin" sourceRef="ReceiveTask_CompanyStatusUpdates" targetRef="Gateway_InternshipJoin"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_JoinToTweet" sourceRef="Gateway_InternshipJoin" targetRef="SendTask_TweetRecommendation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TweetToEnd" sourceRef="SendTask_TweetRecommendation" targetRef="EndEvent_End"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
